label: 🌐 REST API (generic)
description: One configurable connector for any JSON-returning REST API. Handles auth (bearer / api-key / basic), JSONPath extraction, and four pagination styles (cursor, offset/limit, page-number, Link header). Use when there's no purpose-built connector for your source.

auth_kind.label: Authentication
auth_kind.help: How to authenticate. bearer: 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. api_key_query: appends ?<keyname>=<key> to the URL. api_key_header: '<keyname>: <key>'. basic: 'Authorization: Basic <base64(user:pass)>'.

auth_value.label: Auth value (bearer token / API key / user:pass)
auth_value.help: Sensitive — only the connector sees this; not echoed in logs. For basic auth, format as 'username:password'.

auth_param_name.label: API-key parameter name
auth_param_name.help: Used only with api_key_query (URL ?<name>=...) or api_key_header (header <name>: ...).

json_path.label: JSONPath to records
json_path.help: Where in the response the records live. '$' = the whole body is an array. '$.data' = response.data is an array. '$.results.items' = nested. Supports dotted paths only (no [*] wildcards).

pagination.label: Pagination style
pagination.help: none: single fetch. cursor: response includes a cursor field, sent as ?<cursor_param>=<cursor> on next call. offset_limit: ?offset=N&limit=M. page_number: ?page=N. link_header: follows the Link: <...>; rel="next" header.

cursor_response_path.label: Cursor field in response (for cursor pagination)
cursor_response_path.help: JSONPath to the cursor in each response. e.g. 'next_cursor', 'meta.next', 'pagination.cursor'.

max_pages.label: Maximum pages to fetch
max_pages.help: Hard cap to prevent runaway pagination. Adjust if your API has more pages.
